title: an invalid ~/.jitso/config.yaml fails every catalog command with exit 3 and names the problem
source: intended: builds come from layers (repo, trusted parent folders, user folder), nearest wins (docs/decisions.md)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-12, build layers). The user config decides which folders are layers, so an invalid one is an environment error for every command that loads the catalog (build list, launch): exit 3 and `jitso: ~/.jitso/config.yaml is invalid: <problem>`. The rows cover a relative path, `~`, `~/`, `/` and HOME (too broad), an unknown key, a value that is not a list, a version other than 1 and a top level that is not a mapping.

rows: trusted parent "clients" must be an absolute path or start with ~/
trusted parent "~" is too broad (the filesystem root or HOME)
trusted parent "~/" is too broad (the filesystem root or HOME)
trusted parent "/" is too broad (the filesystem root or HOME)
trusted parent "{{HOME}}" is too broad (the filesystem root or HOME)
trusted_parents must be a list of folders
the top level is not a mapping
